newsitem.title: USA: Universal Hospital inks pact with Premier.
newsitem.headline: Universal Hospital inks pact with Premier.

text.p: Universal Hospital Services Inc said Wednesday it signed an agreement to rent medical equipment and provide services to Premier Inc, the nation's largest health care alliance.
Universal Hospital said the pact offers Premier members special rates, discounts and incentives on movable medical equipment for critical care, respiratory therapy, newborn care and wound care.
Universal Hospital provides mobile medical equipment.
Its shares closed off 1/16 Wednesday at 11-1/8.
